summary: New box Preterit-wa: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (Jan 1.4/72)

data.turoyo: I naqqa ak kurd d qayimi li raġlo baʕ ʕəsriyat (20) msarganwolən noše mu ʕamayḏan ste.
data.translation: When the Kurds rose in revolt in the twenties (20), they used to exile people from our people too.

rationale: First I Preterit-wa 1, with an overt zero-marked deportee phrase and political time frame; source -n- before -wo is retained.

summary: New box Preterit-wa: example for sense 1 in Preterit-wa (Jan 1.29/1337)

data.turoyo: ʕAmmo Išoʕ: Msarganwolle am məḏyoye, aṣ ṣəroye w aṭ ṭaye d kətwayye “ileri gelenler“. Yaʕni d kətwolle ǧġaliye, d kətwən rabe.
data.translation: Uncle Ishoʕ: They had exiled the people of Midyat, the Christians and the Muslims who were ‘ileri gelenler’ [prominent people]. That is, those who had a voice, who were important.

rationale: Thin Preterit-wa 1; named prominent Christians and Muslims specify the patient while the authorities remain implicit.

summary: New box Infectum-wa: example for sense 1 in Infectum-wa (Jan 1.29/1337)

data.turoyo: Kulle msargəniwonne mə Məḏyaḏ. Aṭ ṭaye w aṣ ṣəroye.
data.translation: They used to exile them all from Midyat. The Muslims and the Christians.

rationale: First I Infectum-wa 1: patient -nne and mə-source contrast with the l-agent Preterit-wa in the same account.

summary: The inherited glossary labels this loan verb I; that label and msargalle/msargən are retained even though the root has four consonants.
Turkish sürgün supplies a borrowed exile base. Assimilated n+l in the inherited base form and preserved n before -wo are compatible; no reassignment to srgl is warranted.
Authorities remain implicit, deportees are zero-marked in Preterit-wa, and Infectum-wa indexes them by -nne with mə-source. Context names exclusion from a town, not a separate scatter sense.
No new lexical sense or Detransitive construction is proposed. The root had no round-1 run and its example boxes were empty.
Confirm the person/number segmentation of -lən versus -lle in msarganwolən/Msarganwolle; a plural authority is inferred from context, not reconstructed into the source.
